attributes.description: Asymmetric attributes is on: attribute changes (brightness, colour, effect) apply to these members only. A member is switched on by an attribute change only if it is also in the Power-ON set; a member that is already on is adjusted even if it is not.

power.description: Asymmetric power is on: choose which members turn on and which turn off. The Power-OFF set defaults to the full base set so a group off sweeps everything — keep it that way unless you have a reason not to.
power.title: Power member sets

state.description: Asymmetric state is on: only these members decide whether the group counts as on.

user.description: Base members are every light involved in this group in any way. The smaller sets for each behaviour are picked from these lights in the next steps.

presets_edit.description: A preset only stores the settings you include: switches set to 'unchanged' and member sets left unticked are not stored, and do not change a group when the preset is applied. Each 'Include' switch covers the member-set field directly below it. Ticking 'Delete this preset' discards any other edits on this screen when you save.
presets_edit.title: Edit preset

presets_pick.description: Choose a preset to edit, or create a new one. Presets live in one library shared by all Asymmetric Groups.
presets_pick.title: Edit presets

apply_preset.description: Apply a preset from the shared preset library to an Asymmetric Group. Only the settings stored in the preset are changed.

preset.description: Name of the preset to apply. It must match exactly — see the names with the asymmetric_group.list_presets service, or in a group's Configure → Preset library editor.
preset.name: Preset

apply_preset.name: Apply preset

delete_preset.description: Delete a preset from the shared preset library. Groups that applied it keep their settings (and keep the preset's name in their last_applied_preset attribute).

preset.description: Name of the preset to delete. It must match exactly — see the names with the asymmetric_group.list_presets service, or in a group's Configure → Preset library editor.
preset.name: Preset

delete_preset.name: Delete preset

save_preset.description: Save a group's current switch positions and member sets as a preset in the shared preset library.

entity_id.description: The Asymmetric Group light entity to snapshot.
entity_id.name: Group

overwrite.description: Replace an existing preset with the same name. If a preset with this name already exists and overwrite is off, the save fails.
overwrite.name: Overwrite

preset.description: Name to save the preset under. To replace an existing preset the name must match exactly — see the names with the asymmetric_group.list_presets service, or in a group's Configure → Preset library editor.
preset.name: Preset

save_preset.name: Save preset

list_presets.name: List presets
list_presets.description: Return the full preset library (names and contents) as a service response. Use it in scripts and automations with a response_variable.

set_members.name: Set switches and member sets
set_members.description: Change a group's switches and member sets directly. Only the fields you pass are changed; everything else is left as it is. Member lists are limited to the group's base members. If the group's members already form a cycle — the group containing itself, directly or through a member group — the call is refused; break the cycle by editing the member group that loops back.
